title: Jalon Daniels aims to be "the thermostat" in his first NFL start

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jalon Daniels aims to be "the thermostat" in his first NFL start
sources.description: There were 10 quarterbacks selected in the 2026 draft, but the first rookie quarterback to start a game during the 2026 season will not be part of that group.
